messages:
Ravi Singh: FYI ClearWave (midmarket, analytics) has stalled in activation. Usage plateaued after week 2 of trial. Renewal check at 14 days. Onboarding checklist shows 4/8 items incomplete, integrator team blocked on webhook auth. Thinking a short activation-bridge play.
Nina K.: Any error logs from their webhook attempts?
Ravi Singh: They sent this snippet: `401: invalid signature` and their SRE says signature header missing from our docs example.
Jordan L.: Oof. Docs mismatch could cause devs to pause. I'd do a doc patch + sample curl and propose a timeboxed dev pairing session.
Ravi Singh: Agree. Also noticed they use a lower throughput plan and flagged cost concerns. AM-Beth can confirm concessions history.
AM-Beth: They asked previously about temporary trial expansion but legal denied one-off increases. We can offer a 2-week activation credit + extended support instead of seat changes. Need approval path.
Nina K.: Proposed play: "activation-bridge" - immediate doc fix, 60m dev pairing, offer 2-week usage credit, weekly check-ins, and a short exec sync if not progressed.
Jordan L.: Draft copy for credit offer: ```Hi Claire — to help unblock your devs we9ll patch the docs and provide a 2-week activation credit. We9ll also offer a paired session with one of our integration engineers to walk through webhook auth. No contract changes required.```
Ravi Singh: Love it. Action items: Nina to push docs fix and sample request; Jordan to schedule pairing; AM-Beth to scope credit and confirm Legal ok; I'll tag product/eng if we need a fast doc deploy.
playbook-bot: New play created: "activation-bridge" (PL-6002).
Nina K.: Docs PR opened: https://repo.docs/PR-482 (link)  includes corrected header example and a minimal Node/Go snippet.
Jordan L.: Paired session booked Thu 11am ET, invite to Claire. I'll prepare a 6-step debug checklist: header checks, replay tests, signing key rotation, sample payloads, timestamp tolerances, and a quick eval.
AM-Beth: Legal looped in, they9re okay with a standard credit template. I9ll send the template by EOD and cc Ravi.
Ravi Singh: Customer message: "we paused dev work until we see a minimal sample that works" — they want a working curl in 10m. Jordan can you surface one in the invite?
Jordan L.: Will do. Putting `curl -H "X-CW-Signature: SHA256..." -d @payload.json https://api.redwood/ingest` in the invite notes.
Nina K.: Also adding a small telemetry change to flag 401s with `webhook_signature_missing` event so we can monitor. Eng oncall ok'd a short feature toggle.
playbook-bot: PL-6002 updated  owners: Nina K., Jordan L.; owner: Ravi Singh; due_in: 5d.
Ravi Singh: Risk score 6/10 (activation stall + small cost sensitivity). Plan: run pairing, apply credit within 24h of successful pairing, monitor webhook success metric for 7 days, escalate to exec sync if still blocked after 3 days.
AM-Beth: I'll draft the customer-facing email and send once docs PR merges.
Jordan L.: No blockers from eng, oncall approved telemetry toggle.
Ravi Singh: Thanks all. I9ll update Gainsight and mark account "activation-risk". Will post summary after pairing.
